desc: Prove the center-based characterization and verify that arbitrary extra branches can always be deleted without affecting the retained Snowflake.
Implement and validate the \(O(N\log N)\) per-center descending-capacity algorithm, including \(x,y\ge1\), repeated capacities, paths, and stars.
Produce the final Python solution that reads stdin, computes the maximum retained size, and prints \(N-\text{maximum}\).
